baselineArchive.originalZipVerification: All five baseline ZIP hashes and CRCs verified before editing.

notes: All standalone and connected ZIPs are rebuilt from one implementation and verified byte-for-byte against their production builds and manifest.
Weight editing, publication and comparison have no workbench dialogue. Each result has one teacher question and two short Alex replies; the final response cinematic has three lines.

Near-even keeps three medium effort bands and the inclusive ten-point spread rule. Its visible sequence shows checking criteria, collecting ticks and packing up before the review; hidden/off-screen presentation waits. The risk concerns criterion-based stopping, not an asserted numerical learning loss.

The six task vignettes have different metric-specific props/actions. A neutral table aligns all actual trials under one metric label per row; changed-effort cells have a restrained marker independent of near-even status.

Production browser checks cover all three short-review patterns, first-attempt near-even risk, unchanged effort, repeated scene replies, both experiment orders, both system references, six distinct task illustrations, hidden-page sequence holds and comparison columns at 1366/768/390/320px.

Dialogue model checks cover all integer split classifications and 8,640 complete combination paths without normalized dialogue or emoji repeats. Intentional Replay scene replays preserve their established lines.

The separate partner opening and finished videos remain unmerged. Host harnesses exercise the real Gameplay name/metric handoff; the preview stops at the final theory placeholder without entering Design Lab.

Offline tests serve exact packaged HTML through an in-memory HTTPS origin because managed Chromium blocks file navigation. Direct file opening on the user’s browser and classroom load capacity are not claimed as tested.
Both archive branches and all version-numbered historical ZIPs remain unchanged.
